name: The Ashen Circle
tagline: A harvest fire in a hidden valley, and a circle that never lets it go out.
era: An invented valley, in no particular year
summary: Raise the circle's devotion to 100 while keeping loyalty at 50 or more. Refuse the inner circle if it demands a forbidden rite.
action.light_lantern.desc: Guide a lost traveller into the valley. Adds followers and a little scrutiny; new faces ease paranoia.
action.bring_harvest.desc: Work the fields. Adds funds and a little devotion.
action.cast_effigy.desc: Give a straw figure to the fire. Raises devotion and loyalty and hides the circle from outsiders, but feeds the zealots' paranoia.
codex.fall.winter: The stores ran out before winter and the faithful drifted down the mountain road. (Game ending.)
